svg.title: Précis: parallel LLM agents that read and verify research papers
svg.desc: LLM agents read thousands of papers in parallel; a critic checks every claim against a verbatim quote. Under simulated API rate limits it sustains 166 papers per minute with zero 429 errors; a run killed with SIGKILL resumes with no request paid twice; 2,896 arXiv papers parsed. Diagram: fetch, reader agent, critic, reviser loop, topics and report, with one gateway for every model call.
